sources.temperature: NASA GISTEMP global annual mean (J-D), degrees Celsius anomaly
sources.sea_ice: NSIDC September Arctic extent, million square kilometres
sources.wildfires: NIFC annual U.S. wildfire count and acres burned

notes: Only years present in all three sources are retained.
Original downloaded files remain in data/raw.
Normalized values depend on the overlapping years in this run.
Normalization is a scale transformation, not a measure of causation.
NIFC's 2004 figures exclude North Carolina state lands.
